base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: Single-pair PHY management combines Clause-22 basics (BMCR/BMSR + PHY ID) with Clause-45 MMDs (PMA/PMD = DEVAD 1, PCS = 3, AN = 7) and vendor/PLCA registers. The distinctive single-pair items are the master/slave timing config, the SNR/MSE link-quality readout, and — for 10BASE-T1S — the PLCA control/status (enable, node ID, node count, transmit-opportunity timer).
register_address_scheme: Single-pair PHYs are managed over MDC/MDIO using the IEEE 802.3 Clause-22 basic registers (BMCR/BMSR + a few standard registers) plus Clause-45 MMD extensions (5-bit PRTAD + 5-bit DEVAD + 16-bit register) for the PMA/PMD, PCS, Auto-Negotiation, and vendor MMDs that hold master/slave config, SNR/MSE, PLCA control, and EEE.

fcs_polynomial.name: IEEE 802.3 CRC-32
fcs_polynomial.covers: DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad (NOT Preamble + SFD).
fcs_polynomial.bit_order: LSB-first within each byte; FCS appended MSB-byte first.
fcs_polynomial.note: UNCHANGED; the FCS is a MAC-layer integrity check.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PMA/PMD
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Single-pair PMA control/status: master/slave timing config, echo-canceller / equaliser state, link-training control, SNR, MSE, test modes.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PCS
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Ternary PCS status: 4B3B+3B2T / 80B/81B descrambler lock, block lock, link status.

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: Auto-Negotiation
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: Single-pair auto-negotiation (master/slave resolution, EEE capability, speed).

clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.name: PLCA + vendor
clause45_mmd_devad_assignments.purpose: PLCA control/status: enable, node ID, node count, beacon timer, transmit-opportunity timer; vendor echo-canceller taps + diagnostics.

clause22_basic_registers.name: BMCR (Basic Mode Control)
clause22_basic_registers.purpose: Reset, speed select (10/100/1000), duplex, power-down, master/slave manual config bit.

clause22_basic_registers.name: BMSR (Basic Mode Status)
clause22_basic_registers.purpose: Link status, training/auto-neg complete, capability bits.

plca_registers_summary.name: PLCA Control 0 (enable)
plca_registers_summary.purpose: Enable/disable PLCA on the 10BASE-T1S multidrop segment.

plca_registers_summary.name: PLCA Control 1 (node count + local node ID)
plca_registers_summary.purpose: Total node count and this PHY's PLCA node ID (0 = coordinator).

plca_registers_summary.name: PLCA Status
plca_registers_summary.purpose: PLCA active / beacon seen / collision-free state.

plca_registers_summary.name: PLCA Transmit-Opportunity Timer (TOTMR)
plca_registers_summary.purpose: Duration of each node's transmit opportunity.

plca_registers_summary.name: PLCA Burst Control
plca_registers_summary.purpose: Max burst count / burst timer for back-to-back frames in one TO.

link_quality_registers_summary.name: MSE
link_quality_registers_summary.purpose: Mean-squared error after echo cancellation + equalisation; below-threshold = link-up criterion.

link_quality_registers_summary.name: Master/Slave config + resolution
link_quality_registers_summary.purpose: Manual or auto master/slave role and the resolved role.

link_quality_registers_summary.name: EEE / LPI control + status
link_quality_registers_summary.purpose: Energy Efficient Ethernet Low-Power Idle enable + state.
